name: RoboParty
summary: RoboParty is a Shanghai company developing bipedal humanoid robots and open-source robotics platforms. Its work combines mechanical design, embedded electronics, motion control and engineering documentation for education, research and developer use. The company publishes the Roboto Origin humanoid platform with material covering its structure, electrical system, training and deployment.
